payload.title: Headless solver test: cursor continuity and continuation labels over every layout scenario
payload.description:
lib/newspaper-layout.ts (3460 lines) is referenced by zero tests. Its only coverage is Playwright BDD that needs a dev server on port 3001 and never runs in CI. features/step_definitions/layout.steps.js never reads textRanges, startCursor or endCursor, so duplicated or skipped article text between a teaser and its continuation would pass today.

Fix: add a headless test (pattern: scripts/test-blog-feature-solver.ts:11-19 stubs OffscreenCanvas.measureText) that runs buildNewspaperLayout over every fixture in lib/layout-scenarios.ts at 1280, 640 and 390 widths and asserts, per articleId in page order, that range[i].endCursor === range[i+1].startCursor, that the last range is exhausted or carries a jumpLabel, and that pages.length matches the plan. Add continuation-label assertions: SEE <SLUG> ON A<n> / <SLUG> FROM A<n>, the MORE / FROM A<n> no-shortSlug variant, and a two-hop continuation (A1 to A2 to A3) whose second heading must read FROM A2, which will fail until the label bug is fixed (see the sibling issue). Add a small unit test for lib/pretext-layout.ts covering line-capacity off-by-one, a full-width obstacle row, and hasMore probing after the last fully visible line.

Done when: the test runs in CI and fails if a cursor is duplicated or skipped in any scenario.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
